sentences.text: Social worker Rachel Burns attended the assessment with District Nurse Siobhan Kelly.
Siobhan Kelly reported she was concerned about the condition at Keith Dawson's home.
Keith Dawson lives in a property rented from a housing association.
Keith Dawson reported his GP is Dr Morgan at Holloway surgery and he has not been there for ages.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly has been visiting Keith Dawson twice a week for two weeks to treat leg ulcers on both legs, which she noted are slow to heal.
Keith Dawson reported the boiler broke down in October and there has been no heating since then.
Keith Dawson reported there is no hot water.
Keith Dawson uses a fan heater but stated it costs a fortune and he does not use it.
Keith Dawson reported he has not washed in three to four weeks.
Keith Dawson reported rats in the kitchen, having seen two, and stated he does not go into the kitchen much now.
Keith Dawson reported the rats have been present for a few weeks and have been at the bread.
Keith Dawson reported he eats soup and beans, mostly from tins.
Keith Dawson stated carers were supposed to provide him with a meal.
Keith Dawson has a home care package called 'Bright Days' scheduled for morning and teatime.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly reported the log book showed 16 missed visits out of 28 scheduled visits in the last two weeks, with no entries for those 16 visits.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly reported that on four days last week no one came and Keith told her he had no meal on those days.
Keith Dawson stated he did not ring the carers because he did not want the bother.
Keith Dawson described the neighbour as a 'nosy cow' and stated he is not getting into it.
Keith Dawson stated he wants the heating fixed and the rats gone, and explicitly denied wanting a home.
A neighbour at number twenty-five told District Nurse Siobhan Kelly that Keith has been drinking heavily.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly stated she has not seen any sign of heavy drinking herself; the information is second-hand from the neighbour.
Keith Dawson reported his brother Phil lives in Northby and they talk at Christmas.
Keith Dawson reported his wife left in 2015.
Keith Dawson reported he lives on ESA and is waiting for his pension next year.
Keith Dawson reported the gas is on a meter.
Keith Dawson agreed to the social worker raising a safeguarding concern regarding the missed care visits and the state of the house.
Social worker Rachel Burns agreed to contact the housing association and log the boiler as an emergency repair.
Social worker Rachel Burns agreed to ask for two oil heaters to be dropped off today or tomorrow.
Social worker Rachel Burns agreed to contact environmental health for pest control in the kitchen.
Social worker Rachel Burns agreed to raise the missed visits with Bright Days and the commissioning team today.
